system.description:
• Rangers who walk the old green paths and learned the druids' quiet magic along the way.
  • Nature Magic: From 5th level, cast divine Nature spells from the Druid list, up to 4th level, using the Paladin Spells Per Day table.
  • Wisdom is your casting stat, and your spell DC is 10 + half your Ranger level (minimum 1) + your Wisdom modifier.
  • You prepare spells each morning from the Druid list, as a Druid does.
  • Warden's Lore: Advantage on checks to identify plants, animals and natural omens.
